description: Script to run the 'oxlint' tool with a lock mechanism to ensure exclusive access, applying local policies and executing in the current process environment.

methods.name: applyLocalOxlintPolicy
methods.description: Applies local policies to the given command-line arguments and environment variables.

methods.name: acquireLocalHeavyCheckLockSync
methods.description: Acquires a lock to ensure exclusive access to the oxlint process, preventing concurrent execution conflicts.
